effect.reply: Sharp, like a lime-kiln, since the spring flood. The wash comes out stiff. I told the tannery. They said their pits don't leak. Pits always leak.

effect.words: Does your Runnel draught do anything?
effect.reply: It does what the label says. It soothes. Folk want something in a bottle when their pups cough, and I sell bottles. Is that a crime now?
Chalk, mint and river water. Runnel water, likely, which is the joke of it. Willow bark and thyme syrup do more good. Tell the nurse I'll make them at cost.

effect.words: Your lime-pits drain into the Runnel.
effect.reply: Do they? The flood shifted the old culvert, I'll grant that. I can't shut the tannery, #address#. Half the Sump wears my leather. Bring me four of bricks for a soakaway and I'll dig it myself.

effect.words: Pay back the Sump for every bottle.
effect.reply: Every bottle? Bright One, you'd beggar me. Here. Four pennies' worth, and carry it to the courts yourself, since you're so fond of them.

phases.journal: A wet cough is going round the courts by Cistern Court, worst in the pups who drink from the Runnel.

effects.text: Mind the Runnel water. Boil it, or don't drink it. We've pups coughing in every cot.
Thyme syrup? Bring me herbs and I'll brew it the old way, with honey, not sugar. A spoon at night and one at dawn. I cough in the damp myself.

effects.text: Boil the Runnel water. And they say the cough's up at the Residence too. Damp doesn't care whose lungs it gets.

quests.title: The Runnel Cough
quests.summary: A wet cough in the courts round Cistern Court, worst in the pups. The nurse at the Sump Infirmary needs willow bark, and legs to carry remedies.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Every cot is full and half of them are pups. A wet cough from the courts round the cisterns, worst in those who drink from the Runnel, and no thyme syrup left. Bring me willow bark, carry remedies to the coughing houses, and ask the washhouse keeper about his water.
offer.handIn: The washhouse water smells of lime.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Lime. Then it isn't the damp alone, it's the water. Bright One keep the pups. Walk the Runnel back to where it goes bad, and find who's fouling it.
